notes.title: Update | Patch 1.0.0.1-9671 / January Tournament Details
notes.content:
[b]Post launch update (1.0.0.1-9671)[/b]
This update contains bug fixes and a few balance tweaks.
We will keep updating the game as we go and provide balance updates as much as we can.


[u][b]Achievements[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Achievements system has been reworked and fixed. You have to redo them to unlock those that were not unlocked before. There can be a few seconds before an achievement is performed and Steam gives you the achievement info.
[/list]
[u][b]Training Room[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Ultimate and Special infinites are now activated for both players instead of just player 1.
[*]Max combo damage is not reset to 0 when player resets the characters.
[/list]
[u][b]General Gameplay[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Guard break requires more hits now (450 damages instead of previous 300), but takes slightly longer to regenerate.
[*]All special startups in movelists have been fixed and set to actual value (held versions add the expected amount of frames to hold to the startup value)
[/list]
[u][b]Rook[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Ultimate has advantage over any other command grab.
[/list]
[u][b]Knight[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Air special hitbox does not start before it starts moving horizontally.
[/list]


[u][b]Official Checkmate Showdown Tournament[/b][/u]
Mark your calendars - the Checkmate Showdown Tournament will be held on [b]Saturday January 20th 2024![/b]

Here are a few points about the tournament:
[list]
[*]For NA only (EU tournament TBD)
[*]No WiFi connection permitted. A connection test will be mandatory before games.
[*]1000$ prize pool stays the same. EU will be a smaller prize pool
[*]Top 128 reduced to Top 64
[*]You have until **January 5th 11:59PM EST** to qualify
[*]Those who make top 64 will be messaged via Steam by KC from BadRez
[*]Winners will be paid out directly through Paypal or by Matcherino as it is a preferred method of payment to ensure transparency.
[/list]

For more details, [url=https://discord.gg/gpMrfByn5H]join our Discord of 3k+ members![/url]

notes.title: Update | Patch 1.0.0.1-9616
notes.content:
[b]Post launch update (1.0.0.1-9616)[/b]
This first update mainly contains fixes for recurring issues in the game and balancing tweaks.
We will keep updating the game as we go and provide balance updates as much as we can.


[b]Online[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed ranked scoring issues where some players lost points when winning and earned points when losing. From now on, players will earn at least 5 rank points when they win a match.
[*]Leaderboards display the correct rank for the current player.
[*]Added more time before deciding if players can cancel a ranked match if the ping is above 100ms.
[/list]

[b]General Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Short hop can no longer cancel into full hop if players hold down while short hoping.
[*]All ultimates now auto correct at start.
[*]Combo Breaker can now be used with LT+B (Ultimate modifier + Special), as well as the usual RT+B (Dash + Special)
[/list]

[b]Bishop[/b]
[list]
[*]5S is now -5 on block, can be countered if used in a blocked string.
[*]2H is -15 on block, can be interrupted if used in a blocked string.
[*]JS now hits if closer to the floor.
[*]JS is now 0 on block (instead on +10 if executed close to the floor).
[*]Overall makes less damage on shield.
[/list]

[b]Knight[/b]
[list]
[*]6S Teleport is now minus on block.
[*]5S is now punishable if blocked.
[/list]

[b]Rook[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where command grab (5S) could be used before player jumps at wake up.
[*]JH can no longer restand opponent.
[/list]

[b]Queen[/b]
[list]
[*]2S is now 8 on startup (faster) and has armor during charge.
[*]6S tap is no longer safe on block.
[*]Overall makes less damage on shield.
[/list]

[b]King[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with the Ultimate pawns that could be blocked sometimes.
[*]JH can no longer restand opponent, as well as neutral tag assist (5A).
[*]Fixed UI issue showing wrong startup data for 5S. 5S is 5 frames of startup.
[/list]

notes.title: Update | Upcoming Tournament Details / Streamers / Changelog
notes.content:
[h3]It's been over 24 hours since we launched Checkmate Showdown and we already have some news for you![/h3]

[u][b]Official Checkmate Showdown Tournament[/b][/u]
The 1st official Checkmate Showdown Tournament will be held in early January 2024 - for ranked players only.

[b]How it works[/b]
The top 128 players will receive an invitation to our first official tournament with a prizepool of 1000$. You read that right - [b]ONE. THOUSAND. DOLLARS.[/b] With a prizepool this big, this makes us one of the biggest indie fighting game tournaments ever.

We have a two week buffer or "pre-season" for ranked meaning you have two weeks to lab and try stuff out to get a sense of the gameplay. Then, [b]as of Dec 1st[/b], leaderboards will be reset and the race to qualify for top 128 commences.

We'll have a proper loser's bracket meaning we'll have 1st, 2nd and 3rd place prizes. 
We're curious to know: [b]How would you like to see the prizepool divided?[/b]

For more details, [url=https://discord.gg/gpMrfByn5H]join our Discord of 3k+ members![/url]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

In creator news, we clapped Forsen today at the game and NorthernLion did a pretty good job at clapping someone else.

[previewyoutube=Q0VpChuZ9Yw;full][/previewyoutube]

Speaking of, if you are a content creator or you know a content creator that would like to try our game, you can redirect them to our [url=https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/2c1103cd]Keymailer request page![/url]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[u][b]Changelog[/b][/u]
Thank you for your patience on this. Here is the list of all improvements and changes that occurred throughout the demo up until the game release:

[b]Animations[/b]
With the feedback provided by our community, we have reworked almost all animations in the game so they are way smoother than before.

[u][b]Gameplay and mechanics[/b][/u]
[b]Throw cancel[/b]
Throws can now be cancelled by using a special move or a special dash/jump cancel. However, the tradeoff is that the damage is reduced and the following moves will start at a much higher scaled down

[b]Short jump[/b]
To ensure that the short jump is accessible to everyone, as it is a crucial mechanic for combos and movements, there are two ways to perform it. You can either hold down the jump button while pressing it, OR you can quickly tap the jump button or upward on the joystick.

[b]Command grab armor on startup[/b]
Rook's command grabs and Queen 2S now have armor on their startup frames. This ensures that the move will be performed correctly even if you get hit it after it connects.

[b]Frame data adjustment[/b]
Numerous adjustments have been made to the frame data throughout the game in order to achieve better balance. These adjustments have been applied to the movesets of all the characters. You will have the opportunity to check the frame data for each move in the move list of every character.

[b]Game feel adjustment[/b]
We made efforts to minimize awkward interactions to enhance the smoothness of the game. Additionally, we focused on creating an enjoyable game experience overall. We aimed to provide satisfying moves and combos throughout the game to maximize player enjoyment.

[b]Locomotion update[/b]
To ensure that each character feels unique, we have made some changes to their locomotion. Specifically, we have focused on the Queen and the Bishop to better align their movement with their respective archetypes of "Footsie" and "Rushdown".

[b]Knight Rework[/b]
Knight is now more committed to the Zoner archetype
Special moves no longer cost anything but have a longer recovery time (except for 5S).
After hitting an opponent, you can use the special button again to consume a special bar and teleport to the point of impact of the projectile.
Knight's back dash and aerial back dash have been transformed into teleportation abilities.
The Knight’s move speed as been reduced to fit better with his archetype

[b]Queen Rework[/b]
Queen has less recovery on her dashes and her overall mobility has been buffed

[u][b]Online play[/b][/u]
[b]Netcode[/b]
We improved our netcode a lot based on beta and demo matches analyses. Feel free to tell us how that works for you now 

[b]Ranked matchmaking[/b]
Ranked matchmaking is now available. Each player has an Elo rating, and you will be matched against players with similar Elo ratings to ensure fair matches. Additionally, we have added a leaderboard that displays the best players based on their ranks and Elo ratings.

[u][b]Game Modes[/b][/u]
[b]New game mode: Chess 960[/b]
A new non-competitive game mode has been added: Chess 960. In this mode, the main pieces are placed in a random order following the Chess 960 rules. Specifically, the King must be positioned between his rooks, and the Bishops have to be placed on black and white squares. Pieces placement are mirrored so there is no RNG disadvantage. You can play it online in a private match as well.

[b]AI available[/b]
Now you can play against AI locally, which will assist new players in getting into the game. Please note that there is no difficulty scaling, as the AI is not perfect. Its purpose is to help players become familiar with the game mechanics.

[b]Training room update[/b]
We have updated the training room with a few upgrades to facilitate labbing. These upgrades include enabling fast regeneration on combo breaker and tag assist. Furthermore, the fast regeneration applies to both characters.

[u][b]General[/b][/u]
[b]Achievements[/b]
The game now has a total of 26 achievements. All the achievements can only be unlocked in an online match (casual or ranked). Some of them are hidden. Have fun discovering all of them.

[b]Added French, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese languages[/b]
We did the translation on our own so feel free to message us if any translation is bad or should be replaced.

[b]Audio[/b]
Add 2 new soundtracks for the Arch map and polish the existing one.
Include missing sound effects, such as the Queen ultimate.

[b]Polish Maps and VFX[/b]
Edit the lighting and add VFX to make the maps feel more alive and pleasing to see.

[b]Polish UI[/b]
We have added icons for the moves, allowing you to easily remap each input. Additionally, we have made changes to the combo breaker icon to improve visibility when it is ready or charging up.

notes.title: Checkmate Showdown is OUT NOW on Steam!
notes.content:
[b][h3]Are you ready to become the ultimate competitor?[/h3][/b]
We're excited to say that Checkmate Showdown is [b]AVAILABLE NOW[/b].

From the Closed Beta to the Demo, local events here in Montreal to being invited to Evo in Las Vegas - we can't thank you enough for your continued support and your genuine interest in our game. We're excited to show you what's in store so take a minute to read through our update just so you don't miss anything!

[previewyoutube=18w10Y_gJKk;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]What to expect[/b][/u]
[list]
[*][b]Casual matches:[/b] Enjoy a full Checkmate Showdown experience without the sweat.
[*][b]Ranked matches:[/b] Enjoy a full Checkmate Showdown experience WITH sweat & leaderboards.
[*][b]Private matches:[/b] Play against a friend or a viewer with a room code!
[*][b]Chess960:[/b] Randomize the starting position of each major piece.
[*][b]Local Vs./CPU Vs.:[/b] Hop on the couch, plug in an extra controller and fight each other or a bot!
[*][b]Practice mode:[/b] Head into the training room and start labbing combos, tag-assist, etc!
[*][b]5 classic characters:[/b] Each with their own distinct moveset, attitude and abilities!
[*][b]Rollback netcode:[/b] For minimal latency and smooth gameplay. Also it's 2023.
[*][b]Input customization:[/b] Because the community said so!
[/list]
Although you can play with a keyboard, we recommend using a controller. We are compatible with most controllers including fightsticks, just make sure everything is properly setup in your [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/steam_controller/device]Steam controller input[/url] settings. If you're looking for someone to play against, you can always [url=https://www.discord.gg/gpMrfByn5H]join our Discord of 3000+ members[/url] and head into the #LookingForMatch channel and post your lobby code!

Before we get into our launch update, including upcoming events... [b]Please leave a review! Leaving a review helps us a lot in terms of discoverability and is the best way to support us after buying! We're trying to get 10 reviews in the first few hours![/b]

[u][b]Bugs[/b][/u]
Although they should be at a minimum, you will most likely find some - this is okay! The best way to let us know about any bug you encounter is through Discord. [url=https://www.discord.gg/gpMrfByn5H]Join our Discord server[/url] and head into the #bugs channel. The more information you have about the bug and your PC specs (including screenshots/videos,) the easier it is for us to process it.

[u][b]Ranked[/b][/u]
Ranked will be available at launch however we will be resetting leaderboards two weeks from now (Nov 30th). We need to make sure everything is running smoothly so we're giving ourselves a two week buffer. This means that your ranked status will start "counting" as of Dec 1st 2023. Thank you for understanding!

[u][b]Events[/b][/u]

[u]Brilliant move of the week[/u]
[url=https://discord.gg/gpMrfByn5H]We have a channel in our Discord[/url] called #clips where you can post your brilliant plays/combos/moments. Every week, we'll pick one lucky winner and highlight them on our social media platforms. You might even win a prize!

[u]Combo Competition[/u]
We'll be hosting a combo competition in our Discord in 2024 after giving you all enough time to lab with each character. More info soon on Discord.

[u]Monthly Community Tournaments[/u]
Tournaments will be held every month in Discord (could be bi/tri weekly) hosted by devs and community members (mods). We'll try to match skill level as best we can so every level of player is welcome! For bragging rights, Discord roles and game keys!

[u]Hand and Brain[/u]
Imagine this:

JWong being instructed by Alexandra Botez vs Daigo being instructed by Andrea Botez. Thirteen seconds left on the clock, 2 pieces left for each player, only half HP, commentary done by your favorite chess and FGC caster - chaos ensues. Checkmate Showdown Hand & Brain Showmatch.

For now, this is a vision of ours but we're throwing it out in the universe because we'd love to see it happen for real. If you know anyone that can help make this happen, please reach out in Discord!

[u][b]**Official Checkmate Showdown Tournament**[/b][/u]
The 1st official Checkmate Showdown Tournament will be held in [u]Early January 2024[/u] - for [u][b]ranked[/b][/u] players only.

Upon release on November 15th, ranked players will have about 2 months to grind. The top 128 players will receive an invitation to our first official tournament with a prizepool of [b]1000$[/b]. You read that right - ONE. THOUSAND. DOLLARS. With a prizepool this big, this makes us one of the biggest indie fighting game tournaments [u]ever[/u].

If you're looking for a new game to grind, this is your chance.

That being said, we'll also have a tournament production company helping us out with this so stay tuned...

For more info, [url=https://www.discord.gg/gpMrfByn5H]head over to our Discord[/url].



[u][b]Additional Info[/b][/u]

[u]Console release[/u]
We're currently working on porting to [b]PlayStation 5[/b]! We're not sure when it will be ready but we'll keep you all informed on the release date once we know more through Discord or [url=https://twitter.com/Checkm8Showdown]Socials[/url]

[u]Steam Deck[/u]
As of right now, we are not optimized for the Steam Deck. We are investigating this issue and we'll know more soon - Apologies for the inconvenience.


[u]Future plans[/u]
At BadRez Games, we're very keen on making and shaping games with the help of our community.

Through community feedback and testing phases, we were able to make key quality additions to Checkmate Showdown and we will always continue doing so with our future titles. Whatever you want to see, we can make it happen as long as it's agreed upon by the majority and it makes sense for the game. If you're interested in this type of community management, please consider following us on our journey!

If we're successful enough with Checkmate Showdown, we will continue supporting the game throughout the next year. This could be in the form of additional features but mainly for balancing as of right now. We'll always listen to what you have to say and if something needs to be changed, we'll put a plan in action to address those changes.

As for other Game Modes, we have a bunch of cool ideas suggested by the community that could be really fun for Checkmate Showdown. While we'd love to have every game mode & modifier possible, having the necessary resources will depend entirely on the player base feeding it. On our end, we will try our best to bring as many people as we can to the game but [u]your help[/u] is greatly appreciated as well - whatever form it comes in.


What started off as a funky idea to make an accessible fighting game with a twist quickly turned into an FGC validated game. With the help of the BadRez community on Discord, we were able to add even more depth to it and make this game the best it can be.

If you have any questions, please feel free to comment below and we'll get to you as soon as possible.

For now... GET IN HERE AND DEFEAT THE KING!👑👊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1803410/Checkmate_Showdown/

notes.title: Launching November 15th with a 15% launch discount!
notes.content:
We have some BIG news for you, including information on the Checkmate Showdown Tournament in early 2024 and last minute surprises but first...

Only [b]TWO[/b] more weeks until the game releases!

Checkmate Showdown will be available on November 15th 2023. The game will be priced at [b]19.99$USD + a 15% launch discount[/b] ([b]grab it while it's on sale![/b])

Here's a few things to know before launch:

[u][b]Casual/Local Vs[/b][/u]

For our Casual players out there, you'll be able to go into casual play and be matched against someone of your own skill level so you can enjoy a full Checkmate Showdown experience without the sweat.

If you're looking for offline play, we have a few available options such as [b]vs CPU[/b] and [b]local VS[/b] (either two controllers or 1 controller and 1 KB directly in the same PC). Checkmate Showdown is also compatible with most controllers (including fightsticks), just make sure everything is properly setup in your [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/steam_controller/device]Steam controller input[/url] settings. Remote play is also available.

If you're looking for someone to play against, you can always [url=https://www.discord.gg/gpMrfByn5H]join our Discord of 3000+ members[/url] and head into the #LookingForMatch channel and post your lobby code!

[u][b]Ranked[/b][/u]

Ranked matchmaking will also be available if you'd like to test your skills in this dual-layered fighting game. Leaderboards will show you where you are currently ranked amongst your peers around the world.

Points are won by winning and lost by losing. The more points you have, the higher rank you are.
The scoring is as follows:

[list]
[*] If you [u]win[/u] against a stronger opponent, you win more points.
[*] If you [u]win[/u] against a weaker opponent, you win less points.

[*] If you [u]lose[/u] against a stronger opponent, you lose less points.
[*] If you [u]lose[/u] against a weaker opponent, you lose more points.[/list]

[b][u]Events[/u][/b]

[u]Brilliant move of the week[/u]
For our newer players, [url=https://discord.gg/gpMrfByn5H]we have a channel in our Discord[/url] called #clips where you can post your brilliant plays/combos. Every week after launch, we'll pick one lucky winner and highlight them on our social media platforms + a chance to win a prize!

[u]Combo Competition[/u]
We'll be hosting a combo competition in our Discord in 2024 after giving you all enough time to lab with each character. More info on that soon!

[u]Bi/Tri-Weekly Community Tournaments[/u]
Tournaments will be held every 2-3 weeks in Discord depending on availability, hosted by devs and community members (mods). We'll try to match skill level as best we can so every level of player is welcome!

[u][b]Official Checkmate Showdown Tournament[/b][/u]
The 1st official Checkmate Showdown Tournament will be held in mid January.
[u][b]For ranked players only[/b][/u].

Upon release on November 15th, ranked players will have 2 months to grind. The top 128 players after 2 months (January 15th 11:59PM EST) will receive an invitation to our first official tournament with a prizepool of [b]1000$[/b]. You read that right - ONE. THOUSAND. DOLLARS.

With a prizepool this big, this makes us one of the biggest indie fighting game tournaments [u]ever[/u].

Make sure you lab every character and test out your pawn/tag-assist strats cuz this tournament is going to make Bobby Fischer and Daigo look like chumps.

For more info, [url=https://www.discord.gg/gpMrfByn5H]head over to our Discord[/url]

[u][b]Last minute surprise[/b][/u]
We can now confirm that Checkmate Showdown will have a [b]Chess960[/b] game mode!
[url=https://www.chess.com/terms/chess960]Click here[/url] to learn more about this game mode.

We can also confirm that we're currently working on porting to [b]PlayStation 5[/b]! We'll keep you all informed on the release date once we know more.


[u][b]Development Roadmap[/b][/u]
The future of Checkmate Showdown will rely on the community.

If we're successful enough, we will continue adding on to the game and we'll always be ready to address certain balancing issues thanks to our group of testers on Discord. We'll always listen to what you have to say and if something needs to be changed, we'll put a plan in action.

As for other Game Modes, we have a bunch of cool ideas suggested by the community that could be really fun for Checkmate Showdown. Having these ideas is great, but implementing those ideas in our game requires a number of resources (Time/Money/People). While we'd love to have every game mode & modifier possible, the (indie) reality that we live in means the future of the game depends entirely on the player base feeding it.

We're confident we can keep the hype going for a few months with planned events & streams but if you'd like to help us out and make sure we extend the lifecycle of Checkmate Showdown, you can:

[list]
[*] Spread the good word
[*] Leave a review (this helps us!)
[*] Talk about the tournaments for both casual and ranked players
[*] Share our posts on Social Media
[*] Share with your favorite streamer(s)
[*] [url=https://www.discord.gg/gpMrfByn5H]Join our Discord[/url] and actively participate
[*] Send us clips of your gameplay or use the #CheckmateShowdown hashtag
[/list]

[b]CALL TO FGC[/b]
If you're a TO or if you're in an FGC Discord that runs tourneys, we'd love to add our game to the mix! Contact [b]kevin@manavoid.com[/b] to get in touch!


We're two weeks away from launch and we're making sure everything is just right before release. We can't wait to show you what we've been cooking and to see the community pop off. Hopefully, upon release, a few streamers can help us out by playing. We've reached out far and wide and now we must let the FG gods to their thing.

See you on November 15th!

notes.title: Day 18 - Cramling vs Rosen, Reykjavik Open 2023
notes.content:
Quickly becoming a chess superstar, Anna Cramling is not only a top chess content creator - she's also a 2085 rated Woman Fide Master.

With over 620k subs/170M views on YouTube and 360k followers on Twitch we keep asking ourselves: How does she do it!?🤯

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SNlSdWD.jpg[/img]

Some of her chess savvy may come from the fact that BOTH of her parents are 2500 rated chess GM's

While they both have their own achievements - it's important to note that her mother, Pia, is one of the strongest female players in the world. They even do commentary together!

Anna's aggressive playstyle has served her well many times but don't let it fool you - she's respected by all of her peers and even when she wins, she never fails to highlight her opponent's game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4hPbWIh.jpg[/img]

Eric Rosen is also a Twitch streamer and a YouTube creator that produces educational chess videos for new players. He's an IM with a 2341 rating.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SNKOM0g.jpg[/img]

In 2018, he unwittingly defeated reigning world champion Magnus Carlsen in a bullet game.

[previewyoutube=fL4HDCQjhHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Both Anna and Eric are great contributors to the chess community so it's only natural that these two would face eachother at some point.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xu3x3sU.jpg[/img]

Today's setup comes from the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q6rGJNuyjPk]2023 Reykjavik Open Cramling vs Rosen[/url]

Try it out in our demo today!

notes.title: Day 17 - Byrne vs Fischer, The Game of the Century
notes.content:
The following game, a stunning masterpiece of combination play performed by a boy of 13 against a formidable opponent, matches the finest on record in the history of chess prodigies.

IM Donald Byrne vs 13 year old Bobby Fischer.

This is The Game of the Century.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/riJXuiO.jpg[/img]

We all know Bobby Fischer's story - he would become one of the best to play the game, playing in historical matches numerous times.

This was one of his, if not THE first historical match in his repertoire. He was only 13 years old.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pLIMCAm.jpg[/img]

Donald Byrne was a university professor and international master chess player. He shared the same coach as his brother, GM Robert Byrne and Bobby Fischer.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RUNs6K6.jpg[/img]

With the help of Be6!! - the move that was heard around the world - Fischer chooses to sacrifice the Queen and gained a Rook, two Bishops and a Pawn from the move.

The Game of the Century is one of the greatest chess games in all of chess history.

[previewyoutube=A48B5r8dRTs;full][/previewyoutube]

Today's setup comes from the 1956 match between Byrne and Fischer.

Think you can outsmart Bobby Fischer? Try it out in our demo today!🔽
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1803410/Checkmate_Showdown/

notes.content:
Proud to call him our official ambassador, Mat Thomas is not only a rated chess player - he is a Chessboxing World Champion.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XFGydAe.jpg[/img]

World champ, Streamer & Commentator, he's also the founder of Brawl for a Cause - a nonprofit dedicated to training, equipping and inspiring everyday people to literally fight for what they believe in.

With the mission of donating $1 billion, they've already reached over 700k

[img]https://i.imgur.com/g1vR4Ej.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=NRnQiY9CuOk;full][/previewyoutube]

After Ludwig Ahgren announced the Mogul Chessboxing event in 2022, Matt reached out to let him know that he knew a thing or two about the hybrid sport. Lud then invited him to talk about it during his 50-hour glass box stream. The rest is history.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UBmZl6O.jpg[/img]

Mogul Chessboxing was cancelled this year due to legal reasons.

Officially on the chess.com roster & focusing now on streaming and chessboxing commentary, Matt has been following us since day 1 and is a big fan of the game. He continues to impress with his perseverance and entrepreneurship and we can't wait to see what he'll achieve. We're glad he's on our side

notes.content:
He's a successful chess commentator, capable of predicting the outcomes of games and also a grandmaster, reaching a peak rating of 2647. With a current rating of 2619, we predict that he has a goal in mind - to overcome his PR.

Who else but GM Naroditsky for today's setup.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EwZgeGl.jpg[/img]

Born in sunny California, Naroditsky learned chess at age 6 from his father. Winning tournaments as early as 12 years old, he earned his GM title at age 18.

From there, he played in various tournaments, even beating #2 in the world  Fabiano Caruana (2800) in 2021.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qEqCb4r.jpg[/img]

Although top rated in classical, he frequently ranks at the top of the leaderboards in Blitz and Bullet time controls. He is currently ranked [b]#3[/b] in Blitz on Chess.com, behind #2 Hikaru Nakamura & #1 Magnus Carlsen. He's also ranked #1 in Bullet, ahead of them both.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SSnm8u9.jpg[/img]

By FIDE ratings, Naroditsky is consistently ranked in the top 150 in the World, top 20 in the U.S., and top 100 in Blitz and Rapid.

He is active on YouTube & Twitch, with over 300k followers on each platform.

Focusing on analysis and lessons, he is by far one of the best teachers online, capable of bringing your level of thought to that of high rated chess players.

https://www.youtube.com/@DanielNaroditskyGM

Naroditsky has played many great games but this one is literally his best game.

notes.title: Day 9 - Paul Morphy vs the Duke of Brunswick and Count Isouard, Paris 1858
notes.content:
Before World Championships, before FIDE, before ELO even existed, chess was still going strong.

Let's travel back in time to the 1800's when Paul Morphy was deemed to be the "greatest chess master of his era".

[img]https://i.imgur.com/41kFedq.jpg[/img]

Born in New Orleans to a wealthy family, Paul made the best of it and learned #chess on his own. By the age of nine, Morphy was considered one of the best players in New Orleans.

In 1846, General Winfield Scott visited New Orleans and asked to play against the strongest player in the city. The chess pieces were set up and a young Morphy was brought in. 

Scott was at first offended, thinking he was being made fun of. He consented to play after being assured that his opponent was a "chess prodigy" who would prove his skill.

Morphy easily won both of their two games, the second time announcing a forced checkmate after only six moves.

After his studies, he received an invitation to participate in the First American Chess Congress which is now known as the US Chess Championship. Morphy went on to win and was hailed as the US chess champion.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8lu3Cin.jpg[/img]

Paul traveled all over Europe to challenge the leading players at that time, beating them all by large margins.

He was called "The Pride and Sorrow of Chess" because he had a brilliant chess career but retired from the game while still young.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xbHISKV.jpg[/img]

Morphy was far ahead of his time and is recognized as one of the best to ever play. Praised by GMs such as Fischer, Anand, Euwe, Kasparov - the latter even stated that Morphy is considered both the "forefather of modern chess" and "the prototype of the strong 20th-century grandmaster".

Even though Paul retired at a young age, his legacy will live on forever.

The Queens Gambit even mentions him as Beth Harmon's favorite player and his matches are often used by chess teachers to demonstrate how to use tempo, develop pieces, and generate threats.

Today's setup comes from a famous game against the Duke of Brunswick and Count Isouard at the Italian Opera House in Paris, 1858 known as "The Opera Game".

This game is considered to be Morphy's best game ever played. Read about it [url=https://www.chess.com/terms/opera-game-chess]here[/url].

Play the setup in our demo today!

notes.title: Day 8 - Carlsen vs Niemann
notes.content:
Chess gathers the most disciplined of minds but it isn't impervious to controversy.

In 2022, GM Magnus Carlsen shockingly lost to Hans Moke Niemann which prompted an investigation.

It became "the most serious #scandal about cheating allegations in chess in years".

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Kqp9VjT.jpg[/img]

Chess.com's duty to uphold the standards and fair play policy of the game led to a 72-page report stating that 'Niemann Has Likely Cheated In More Than 100 Online Chess Games'. [url=https://www.chess.com/blog/CHESScom/hans-niemann-report]This report was shared publicly[/url].

Hans has admitted to cheating in online chess in the past, but denied cheating in the game with Carlsen or in any over-the-board game.

[previewyoutube=CJZuT-_kij0;full][/previewyoutube]

This scandal shook the chess world and quickly became the talk of the town.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/D0xTVQJ.jpg[/img]

These accusations that were voiced so publicly prompted Niemann to sue Carlsen and Chess.com for defamation, seeking $100 million in damages. The suit was later dismissed and Niemann was reinstated in the website.

Hans is back to playing chess full time to "make amends" some say. Others say that he now has a giant chip on his shoulder and is on his redemption arc to show the world his true skill. You can watch a recap of the whole ordeal done by WSJ [url=https://youtu.be/eg5G1A_mTFg]here[/url].

Today's setup comes from the 2022 Sinquefield Cup match Carlsen vs Niemann.

notes.title: Day 7 - Tolnai vs Polgar
notes.content:
Widely recognized as the greatest female chess player of all time, Judit Polgar is a Hungarian chess grandmaster achieving the title at just 15 years of age.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BfxJgYz.jpg[/img]

Known for her aggressive playing style, Judit has spoken of "appreciating the psychological aspect of chess." She prefers to learn an opponent's style so she can play intentionally against him or her rather than playing "objective" chess.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BWvlgTk.jpg[/img]

She has played (and won) against some of the best to ever play the game such as Spassky, Kasparov, Shirov, Anand, Kramnik - the list goes on. Here is Judit playing against then World Champion Magnus Carlsen and beating him in just 19 moves.

[previewyoutube=hvbZCRid5CY;full][/previewyoutube]


Holding the title of #1 ranked female player from 1989-2014 (25 years), Judit is not to be messed with.

At the age of 15 years, she broke Bobby Fischer’s record of being the youngest Grandmaster in history. Her victory won her the tournament, a national championship, and a Grandmaster title.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/86EeR2r.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Day 1 - Fischer vs Spassky
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

In order to promote the game of chess a bit more to FGC and to help gain the attention of chess players, every day for the next [b]THREE WEEKS[/b] we'll be updating the demo with a "setup of the day" which puts you in a setup once played by chess pros/streamers (Past and present).

[b]Today's setup is Fischer vs Spassky.[/b]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------

The 1972 World Chess Championship is perhaps the most famous chess match ever played.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XzKBm3O.jpg[/img]

Known as "The Match of the Century", Bobby Fischer (US) challenged defending World Champion Boris Spassky (USSR) for his title.

Fischer had already played against Spassky before this encounter, drawing twice and losing three times. On top of having the World Championship pressure on their shoulders while being watched by the entire world, this match was played during the Cold War era meaning they both faced enormous political pressure to win. The US National Security Advisor had even called Fischer to remind him how important this match was.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/efm97nC.jpg[/img]

Although considered one of the greatest matches ever played, it also saw [url=https://www.chess.com/article/view/match-of-the-century-almost-didnt-happen-fischer-spassky]some rather erratic behavior coming from Fischer[/url] such as demanding more compensation before playing, the removal of the cameras due to their noise, the removal of the 7 first rows of spectators - behavior that commentators (particularly from the USSR) suggested was "part of Fischer's plan to psych out Spassky".

Today's setup in our demo is taken from Game 6 of Fischer vs Spassky where Fischer took the lead by playing the Queen's Gambit for the first time in his life. Relive the moment in Checkmate Showdown:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1803410/Checkmate_Showdown/
